en: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.
Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.

Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.
